FORGE_URL.description: The Forgejo's base URL, for example https://codeberg.org. Required by every command but event.

FORGE_TOKEN.description: A Forgejo API token with the scopes write:repository and write:issue. Required by every command but event.

FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: The secret of the webhooks that webhook registers. When it is set, event refuses a delivery whose X-Forgejo-Signature does not match.
